How to create an account

Open Sedno on your phone. Follow these steps in order.

The red circle shows where to tap. These screens come from the app. The email is an example.

  1. 1 Open the menu

    Tap the person icon at the top right.

    Tap here

  2. 2 Choose “Account”

    Tap the button in the red circle.

    Tap here

  3. 3 Choose to create an account

    Tap “No account? Create one”. If you cannot see it, swipe up.

    Tap here

  4. 4 Enter your email and password

    1. Enter your email address.
    2. Choose a password with at least 6 characters.
    3. Enter the same password again below.
    4. Tap “Create account”.

  5. 5 Open your email

    Find the email from Sedno. Check Spam too. Open the email and tap the link to confirm your email address.

    Tap here

  6. 6 Go back to Sedno

    Open Sedno again. If you still see this screen, tap “Check verification”.

    Tap here

  7. 7 Done!

    You can see your email address. Your account is ready.

Good to know

No email? Go back to Sedno. Wait for “Send email again” to appear and tap it. Then check your email again.
